metadata.scenario: A returning customer is questioning an unexplained fee added to their latest invoice and seeks clarification. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is David Anderson. I'm calling because I noticed an unexplained fee on my wife’s latest invoice. I’m sorry to hear that, David. Let me look into that for you. Can you provide me with the invoice number? Sure, it’s INV-12345. The fee seems to be labeled as "additional services." Thank you for that information. Please hold on for just a moment while I check the details. Okay, no problem. I appreciate your patience, David. It looks like there was an additional charge for extra hours of nursing care. It appears we logged more time than initially scheduled. That’s strange. We didn’t request any extra hours for the last visit. I understand your concern. Let me verify if there was a misunderstanding or an error during the visit. Yes, please do. I’d like to get to the bottom of this. I will reach out to the nurse who provided the care that day and check the time logs. Can I call you back once I have more information? That would be great. What’s the best number to reach you at? You can call me at +13165556203. Also, while we’re on the call, I noticed you mentioned your wife needs physical therapy. Yes, she’s recovering from a stroke, and we’re considering starting therapy soon. We can definitely assist with that. Dr. James Rodriguez, our physical therapist, specializes in stroke recovery. That sounds promising. What are the costs for physical therapy? Our physical therapy sessions range from $110 to $140 for about 45 to 60 minutes. Alright, I’ll consider that while we sort out the billing issue. Perfect. I’ll email you the details for scheduling once we resolve the invoice. Thank you, Margaret. I’ll be waiting for your call. You’re welcome, David. I’ll be in touch soon. Thanks again. Bye! Goodbye!
